values.note: DNR rate table, Orchard Beach campground: $41 with 20/30-amp, $46 with 50-amp, $56 full hook-up. Mini cabin $80, camper cabin $120. A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry into all state park and forest campgrounds, on top of the camping fee.

summary: Confirmed on the DNR pages: $41 (20/30-amp) to $56 (full hook-up) for 2026 with the Recreation Passport in fees.note, season Apr 22 - Oct 21 (manual, unchanged), phone 231-723-7422, and the --AWH note (100-ft bluff; 'Due to erosion, the beach is no longer accessible from the park').
